testimonials.title: Reviews
testimonials.quote1: The best hummus in Poznań — creamy, bold, perfect for sharing.
testimonials.quote2: Shakshuka like in Tel Aviv — we're back with friends every week.
testimonials.quote3: Warm atmosphere, small plates and great service — ideal for an evening out.
testimonials.quote4: Falafel crispy outside, soft inside — exactly as it should be.
testimonials.quote5: Turkish coffee and baklava are a must after dinner.
testimonials.quote6: Colourful interior, good music and flavours that stay with you.
testimonials.quote7: Tabbouleh as fresh as it gets — we come back for lunch.
testimonials.quote8: A place where you really feel the Levant — recommend to everyone.
testimonials.quote9: Muttabal and pita — simple, so good we order twice.
